sourceGeometry.originPolicy: base for floor-standing assets; wall or ceiling for mounted fixtures
sourceGeometry.materials: one shared color material per asset

catalogCommands: npx tsx scripts/renderCatalogPreviews.ts <70 fire-station asset IDs>

parameterVariant.method: rewrite the parameter defaults in an in-memory copy of the .kcad.ts source, export the GLB, and render; the checked-in source retains default values

claimsBoundary.localReplay: the local source and preview workflow only
claimsBoundary.localValidation: catalog source, mesh, preview, page and integration checks
claimsBoundary.hardwareAcceptance: not applicable; assets are generic visualization props
